annotations.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video with sound

description: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 5-second videos with native audio from text or a starting image, at 360p, 720p or 1080p. Compared with other video tools: premium. Price: from $0.238 per 5-second video, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 360p $0.238, 720p $0.710, 1080p $1.048 (default 720p). One call = one 5-second video with sound.
